# package sunspec

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus/sunspec"
```

Package sunspec provides SunSpec marker detection and model chain discovery for Modbus devices.

Users should import this package directly:

	import "github.com/otfabric/go-modbus/sunspec"

## Constants

```go
const (
	MarkerReg0     uint16 = 0x5375 // 'S'<<8 | 'u'
	MarkerReg1     uint16 = 0x6E53 // 'n'<<8 | 'S'
	EndModelID     uint16 = 0xFFFF
	EndModelLength uint16 = 0
)
```

## Variables

```go
var DefaultBaseAddresses = []uint16{0, 40000, 50000, 1, 39999, 40001, 49999, 50001}
```

DefaultBaseAddresses lists the register addresses probed when detecting a SunSpec marker. Address 40000 is the most common starting point per SunSpec Information Model specification. Addresses 0 and 50000 cover devices that place the marker at the very start of the register map or at an alternative base. Addresses 1, 39999, 40001, 49999, and 50001 handle off-by-one deviations observed in real-world devices and gateways.
